articles.title: Meet Swiftiephylus, a group of insects named after Taylor Swift
articles.snippet: Four newly described species of Australian plant bug have been named in honor of world-famous pop star Taylor Swift.
articles.summary: Four newly discovered species of Australian plant bugs have been named in honor of the pop star Taylor Swift. These insects are part of a group called Swiftiephylus.

articles.title: Peru’s penguins are in trouble. A super El Niño could worsen things
articles.snippet: Bird flu, overfishing and warming seas have crashed the world’s largest colony of Humboldt penguins. Scientists are working to help them bounce back.
articles.summary: The world's largest colony of Humboldt penguins has crashed due to bird flu, overfishing, and warming seas. Scientists are now working to help these penguins bounce back.

articles.title: A new flying drone uses touch to perch like a bird
articles.snippet: The drone's human-inspired fingers use touch to get a grip. This avoids some obstacles that come with relying on vision to perch.
articles.summary: A new flying drone uses human-inspired fingers with a sense of touch to grip surfaces like a bird. This touch-based method helps the drone avoid obstacles that usually come with using vision to perch.
